reason: An external-service provider plugin that adds LLMTR’s OpenAI-compatible chat gateway and model catalog to DeepSeek Harness, with configurable credentials, routing, streaming, and model scope.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 LLMTR 兼容 OpenAI API 的聊天模型网关，并提供模型目录、流式响应和凭据配置。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to LLMTR’s OpenAI-compatible chat gateway with model discovery, streaming responses, and configurable credentials.

capabilities: Sends chat completion requests to the LLMTR external API
Retrieves a live model catalog from the LLMTR gateway
Supports streaming responses and usage reporting
Resolves and transmits an LLMTR API key for authentication
Allows configuration of endpoint URLs and request headers
